details:

records.title: Scam in the NEET Exam
details: The Ministry of Education has constituted a High-Level Committee of Experts on 22.06.2024 for making recommendations on Reforms in mechanism of examination process, Improvement in Data Security protocols and Structure and functioning of National Testing Agency.

records.title: Underutilisation of Coal Mines in the Country
details: Hon'ble Minister inter-alia stated as under:- I would like to assure the House that from 2024-25, We will cut the import of thermal coal. This is what I am going to assure to this House.
